Lemma
[Contact-set estimate for the principal part] 1. ch9:9.3\group chapter-9Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0234 If $u\in C^2(\Omega )\cap C^0(\overline\Omega )$ and $d=\operatorname {diam}\Omega $, then \begin{equation} \tag {9.11} \sup _\Omega u\le \sup _{\partial \Omega }u+ \frac d{n\omega _n^{1/n}} \left\| \frac{a^{ij}D_{ij}u}{\mathcal D^*}\right\| _{L^n(\Gamma _u^+)}. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch On $\Gamma _u^+$, apply

\[ \det A\det B\le \left(\frac{\operatorname {tr}(AB)}n\right)^n \tag {9.10} \]

to $A=-D^2u$ and $B=[a^{ij}]$, then use Lemma 10.

□
